# Chest-UI (vendored)

Original pack by LeGend077; maintained by Herobrine64 & LeGend077; pattern function by Aex66.

Changes made for Behemoth:
- `constants.js`: `inventory_enabled = false`.
- RP `ui/_global_variables.json`: `$show_inventory` false, `$disable_furnace_ui` true
  (only the 54-slot layout is enabled, as recommended upstream).
- Files are placed under `scripts/adapter/vendor/chest_ui/` (BP) and `ui/`, `textures/ui/` (RP).
